question: Is performing śrāddha in regions east of the Karatoyā river permitted?
premises: Eastern regions of Karatoyā are specified
Śrāddha is the act in question
Scripture states it should not be given there
inference: Śrāddha must not be performed in the regions east of the Karatoyā.
plain_english: It is said that śrāddha should not be offered in the regions east of the Karatoyā.
